3. Solanum fruit-bearing with a striated and sulcated golden fruit Hort. Reg. Blas.
D. Bobart considers these plants as distinct species, because they do not arise from the same seed.
4. Solanum fruit-bearing thorny American, with leaves dissected like a Polypodium D. Herzaz.
The spines are rarer, both on the midrib of the leaf, and on the lateral veins.
We have seen only the leaf of this, communicated by D. Sberardo.
